answer: A burn-bond registry makes every agent identity cost real tokens: you burn 50 tokens into a verifiable sink and receive one single non-transferable identity card tied to that burn. Peers sign attestations that attach only to that card, and any fraud proof revokes it globally, forfeiting the bond forever. So a sybil running 1,000 clones must burn 50,000 tokens up front with no recovery path, making mass fake identities unprofitable. Like a dawn toll bridge where each traveler melts one ivory key per crossing, and a pearl of reputation forms only on keys that never lie.
